gB-9.mechanism: Full-frame 1280x720 downscaled to 640x640 reduces phone area to <20px; specialist detector missed all 7 instances. Auxiliary detector on native driver crop recovered proposals in all 7.

gC-14.mechanism: Steering wheel occlusion masked phone lower half.

gZ-36.mechanism: Phone interaction duration <1.2s was dropped by default temporal window; 2 cases recovered by auxiliary crop proposals.

fp_breakdown.mitigation: Context filtering (MOUNTED_OR_STATIC removal in gC-14 dropped 1 FP); E2 engine state preservation eliminates fragmented micro-alerts.
